5–10 minGrammar

What is an adverb of manner?

It tells us how somebody does something.

verb + adverb
She speaks quietly.
Normal rule: adjective + -ly
slow → slowly, careful → carefully, loud → loudly
nice → nicely-e stays
easy → easily-y → -ily
good → wellspecial
fast → fastno change

Adjective or adverb?

Adjective describes a noun: It is a slow robot.
Adverb describes an action: The robot walks slowly.

18–24 minListening

Listen: Robot CX-546

Click play. Complete the dialogue with adverbs of manner.

Track 2.32

Listen once for the story. Listen again for the adverbs.

Dr Q: This is my first robot, Pi. It’s very old. Turn it on .
Robot: Hello! I’m CX-546.
Pi: I can’t hear it. It’s talking too (quiet).
Dr Q: How about now?
Robot: HELLO! I’M CX-546!!!
Pi: Now it’s speaking too (loud)! CX-546 is very slow. Can’t he walk (fast)?
Dr Q: No, but he knows how to make toast really (good). Here, try this!
Answers: carefully, quietly, loudly, fast, well.
